attributes.name: AabbMinMax

attributes.name: a
attributes.description: List of a coefficients of plane normals

attributes.name: b
attributes.description: List of b coefficients of plane normals

attributes.name: boundaryNormal
attributes.description: Normal direction of boundary if fixedNormal=True

attributes.name: c
attributes.description: List of c coefficients of plane normals

attributes.name: d
attributes.description: List of d coefficients of plane normals

attributes.name: fixedNormal
attributes.description: Whether to fix the contact normal at a boundary, using boundaryNormal

attributes.name: highlight
attributes.description: Whether this Shape will be highlighted when rendered.

attributes.name: isBoundary
attributes.description: Whether the particle is part of a boundary particle

attributes.name: maxAabb
attributes.description: Max from box centre: Used for visualisation in vtk and qt

attributes.name: maxAabbRotated
attributes.description: Max from box centre: Used for primary contact detection

attributes.name: minAabb
attributes.description: Min from box centre: Used for visualisation in vtk and qt

attributes.name: minAabbRotated
attributes.description: Min from box centre: Used for primary contact detection

attributes.description: Whether this Shape is rendered using color surfaces, or only wireframe (can still be overridden by global config of the renderer).
